'''House D'Vails''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] house that was led by [[Amir D'Vail]], which operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], House D'Vails placed an order with the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]-based company [[Renna's Transport Service]] to take delivery of a cargo of [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]] [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].
